core_reference.title: Global Portfolio Optimization (Financial Analysts Journal)
core_reference.relevance: Confidence-weighted Bayesian portfolio construction의 기원. View confidence Ω matrix 형태로 per-asset uncertainty 정량화. 본 sprint의 confidence vector c_i 가 BL의 Ω에 대응.

core_reference.title: Advances in Financial Machine Learning, Ch. 11
core_reference.relevance: ML uncertainty quantification — bootstrap CV residual std 등으로 per-name forecast uncertainty 측정. 본 sprint의 12M residual std component 근거.

core_reference.title: Machine Learning vs Economic Restrictions: Evidence from Stock Return Predictability (Review of Financial Studies)
core_reference.relevance: ML 모델 ensemble disagreement 기반 confidence sizing이 long-only 위험조정 수익률 개선. 본 sprint의 multi-component composite confidence 직접 근거.

core_reference.title: Active Portfolio Management 2nd Ed., Ch. 7-8
core_reference.relevance: IR = IC × sqrt(breadth). Per-name confidence를 적용하면 effective breadth 증가. 본 sprint의 sub_stab 강화 메커니즘 근거.

core_reference.title: Liquidity Risk and Expected Stock Returns (Journal of Finance)
core_reference.relevance: Model uncertainty in cross-section premia. Per-name posterior variance가 weight shrinkage 기준.
